description: Searches a site's pages by name or title, case-insensitively, on a substring match against Name, display name, Title and NavigationTitle. Returns { Matched, Returned, Truncated, Root, SiteName, Pages: [{ ID, Path, Template, TemplateID }] }. An item counts as a page when it has presentation (a layout on the item or on its template's standard values), which is what makes it addressable as a page — not a guess from template naming.

database.description: The database to read. Defaults to the site's own database, or master.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 500). Matched always reports the true count, and Truncated says whether rows were withheld.

path.description: Any item path inside the site, used to work out which site is meant (e.g. /sitecore/content/Stride/Cova/Home). Supply this or siteName.

query.description: The text to look for in the page's name, display name, Title or NavigationTitle.

rootPath.description: Scan this subtree instead of the site's home item, e.g. to list one section. Must be inside the site.

siteName.description: The site name as Sitecore knows it (e.g. 'Cova'). Use list-sites to see the names. Supply this or path.

name: search-site-pages
